items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Oh, I first met him right here.

ctx.x: Where did you first meet, uh, this fella, Lewis James, anyhow? Lewis James?
The bass player. Oh, I first met him right here. But no, no, I wouldn't say that. I believe I saw him some years back with Gabriel Vann out in the country.
